schema.description: Response schema for a single booking intent via a public interface.

data.description:
A public booking intent that tracks the lifecycle of a booking attempt.
This is a simplified view without sensitive or admin-only fields.

anyOf.description: A public appointment represents a booking that a client has made with a provider for a service.

rescheduling.disabled_message: Rescheduling is not available within 24 hours of your appointment

cancellation.description: Information about whether the appointment can be canceled by the client.

allowed.description: Whether the appointment can be canceled by the client.

disabled_message.description: A message explaining why cancellation is disabled, if applicable. Only present when allowed is false.

confirmed_at.description: Time at which the object was confirmed.

end_at.description: An object describing a date/time in local time and in UTC.

local.description: The local date/time in ISO-8601 format, including the UTC offset (e.g., `2025-03-01T10:00:00-05:00`).

time_zone.description: The time zone of the local time (IANA format).

unix_ts.description: The UTC date/time in Unix timestamp format (seconds).

utc.description: The UTC date/time in ISO-8601 format (with time zone information).

end_at.title: ZonedDateTime

rescheduling.description: Information about whether the appointment can be rescheduled by the client.

allowed.description: Whether the appointment can be rescheduled by the client.

disabled_message.description: A message explaining why rescheduling is disabled, if applicable. Only present when allowed is false.

start_at.description: An object describing a date/time in local time and in UTC.

local.description: The local date/time in ISO-8601 format, including the UTC offset (e.g., `2025-03-01T10:00:00-05:00`).

time_zone.description: The time zone of the local time (IANA format).

unix_ts.description: The UTC date/time in Unix timestamp format (seconds).

utc.description: The UTC date/time in ISO-8601 format (with time zone information).

start_at.title: ZonedDateTime

urls.description: URLs related to the appointment for client-facing actions.

add_to_calendar.description: URLs for adding the appointment to a calendar.

add_to_google_calendar.description: URLs for adding the appointment to Google Calendar.

ics.description: URLs for downloading an ICS file for the appointment.

anyOf.title: PublicAppointment

appointment.description: The created appointment. Present when status is completed.

anyOf.description: An object describing a date/time in local time and in UTC.

local.description: The local date/time in ISO-8601 format, including the UTC offset (e.g., `2025-03-01T10:00:00-05:00`).

time_zone.description: The time zone of the local time (IANA format).

unix_ts.description: The UTC date/time in Unix timestamp format (seconds).

utc.description: The UTC date/time in ISO-8601 format (with time zone information).

anyOf.title: ZonedDateTime

end_at.description: The end time of the selected slot

errors.description: Validation errors for data provided so far. Fields not yet submitted are not flagged. Null when not computed.

items.description: A single validation error in JSON:API format.

example.detail: must be a valid email address
example.title: Invalid value

code.description: Machine-readable error code (e.g. slot_unavailable, no_available_provider, time_range_conflict)

items.title: JsonError

locked_fields.description: Fields that are locked and cannot be updated via the public API.

requirements.description:
Per-section completeness status for a booking intent. Provides boolean
signals for whether each section of the booking flow has enough data
to proceed, enabling the frontend to make navigation decisions without
parsing error pointers.

complete.description: Whether the booking step is complete (provider and slot fields are present).
Whether the info step is complete (required client fields are present).

submissions.description: Per-form completeness status, in the same order as the service's forms.

items.description: Completeness status for a single form submission.

complete.description: Whether the submission exists and all required fields have been answered.

items.title: SubmissionRequirement

requirements.title: BookingIntentRequirements

anyOf.description: An object describing a date/time in local time and in UTC.

local.description: The local date/time in ISO-8601 format, including the UTC offset (e.g., `2025-03-01T10:00:00-05:00`).

time_zone.description: The time zone of the local time (IANA format).

unix_ts.description: The UTC date/time in Unix timestamp format (seconds).

utc.description: The UTC date/time in ISO-8601 format (with time zone information).

anyOf.title: ZonedDateTime

start_at.description: The start time of the selected slot

status.description: The current status of the booking intent. Automatically transitions from pending to slot_selected when provider_id, start_at, end_at, and time_zone are all present (on create or update).

workflow.description:
Server-computed workflow state for a booking intent. Provides step routing,
completability, and defunct state so the frontend can render the correct
booking flow without inferring these from raw fields.

available_steps.description: Ordered list of steps the user can visit. Computed from service forms and locked_fields.

can_change_slot.description: Whether slot fields (start_at, end_at, time_zone) are unlocked and can be modified.

can_complete.description: Whether the intent has enough valid data to submit right now. When true, calling the complete endpoint will succeed regardless of whether the current status is pending or slot_selected.

defunct_reason.description: Why the intent is defunct. Null when not defunct.

is_defunct.description: Whether the intent is in an unrecoverable state and should render a terminal UI.

resume_step.description: The step the UI should show on load or resume. One of: booking, info, form:<form_id>, confirmed, defunct.

workflow.title: BookingIntentWorkflow
